logic.detail: after power returns: LATCH False, K1 open (power-on reset)

logic.case: mushroom tapped (coil loop broken for 0.5 ms) while armed
logic.detail: LATCH False, K1 open

logic.case: AUX wire breaks while running
logic.detail: no FORCE (U6 is held cleared: K2_DRIVE = LATCH ∧ ¬AUX goes high and K2 re-closes), K1 stays closed on PRE_OK: a latent fault; the next stop gets **no forced discharge** (≈ 300 ms of bus on the drives' idle draw). Only the Pi sees it (AUX_OK low → supervisor e-stop latch)

logic.case: AUX stuck closed, then ARM
logic.detail: K1 closes on an empty bus (pre-charge bypassed: Q4 holds on AUX, K2_DRIVE = ¬AUX is off), bus 0.0 V at closing → inrush limited only by ESR / wiring; and no aux edge at the next stop, so no FORCE

logic.case: K1 main contacts welded, heartbeat stops
logic.detail: no aux edge → no FORCE; the bus stays powered from the supply; only the Pi (DISABLE frames) and the drives' CAN timeout remain

logic.case: 12 V gate-driver supply lost (U2 / F2) while running
logic.detail: the comparator still switches but UCC27524 has no supply: no clamp, no FORCE, and K1 stays closed. Regen then charges the bus without limit (M1 1.3 kW into 7 mF: 25 → 28 V in ≈ 0 ms)

logic.case: K1 coil unplugged while running (T7, T9 b), replugged after 0.25 s
logic.detail: AUX opens at +10 ms; **no FORCE**; the AUX edge triggers U6 and clears it in the same edge (race); **K2 re-closes at +20 ms** (pre-charge starts again with LATCH high); **K1 re-closes at +275 ms without ARM**; end: LATCH True, K1 closed

logic.case: K1 coil supply dips for 20 ms (coil wire intermittent, shock)
logic.detail: AUX opens at +10 ms; **no FORCE**; the AUX edge triggers U6 and clears it in the same edge (race); **K2 re-closes at +20 ms** (pre-charge starts again with LATCH high); **K1 re-closes at +45 ms without ARM**; end: LATCH True, K1 closed

logic.case: K1 closing with a 3 ms aux bounce (ESTIMATE burst) at ARM
logic.detail: 4 bounce gaps each trigger U6 and clear it on the same edge (K2_DRIVE = LATCH ∧ ¬AUX follows every gap): a ns FORCE pulse into U10's CLR̄ that may or may not clear LATCH, so the board arms only some of the time; if it takes, the clamp sits across a closed K1 and the bench supply latches off

logic.case: aux contact glitches open for 0.1 ms while running (shock)
logic.detail: race on the glitch edge (U6 triggered and cleared together); K2_DRIVE pulses

logic.case: pre-charge into a 10 Ω load (T4): never reaches PRE_OK
logic.detail: K1 never closes, PRE_TIMEOUT clears LATCH at 1000 ms; FORCE once at +1000 ms as K2_DRIVE falls (SN74LVC1G123 CLR̄ ↑ with Ā low): empties the partly charged bus; none during the pre-charge
